supersessionReason: Independent adversarial review found that v8 reused a delayed not-modified confirmation timestamp as the local exact-byte verification-failure observation time, which could regress heartbeat journaling and roll back permanent-corruption evidence.

notModifiedVerificationObservation.confirmationTimeRule: confirmedAt is immutable source-confirmation evidence time and remains the occurred_at value of a successful not_modified_confirmed event
notModifiedVerificationObservation.verificationObservationTimeRule: exact-byte verification failure is observed on a separate local monotonic clock at verification time; an implementation must never substitute confirmedAt for that observation
notModifiedVerificationObservation.failureJournalRule: permanent or transient exact-byte failure appends its deterministic failure event and alert at verification-observation time, advances last_attempt_at and last_failure_at to that observation, preserves last_success_at, and retains the forensic pointer only as stale
notModifiedVerificationObservation.delayedResponseRule: a delayed or replayed not-modified response whose confirmedAt predates a later heartbeat cannot regress or roll back failure evidence discovered by the later verification observation
notModifiedVerificationObservation.successRule: a successful older confirmation remains append-only evidence but cannot clear a newer failure or regress heartbeat clocks

effectiveContract: source-capture-contract.2026.1 plus v2, v3 except its superseded same-batch pointer clause, v4 except its superseded manifest-time verification clause, v5, v6, v7, v8, and every clarification in this file
